summary.text: Charles Lollar is the Republican candidate for Georgia House of Representatives District 110 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Democratic incumbent Segun Adeyina.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as business.

paragraphs.text: Lollar was a candidate for Governor of Maryland in 2014, losing the Republican primary on June 24, 2014.
He was also the Republican candidate for District 110 in 2024, when he lost the general election to Adeyina, 65.3 percent to 34.7 percent.
Ballotpedia's campaign-finance table lists him as having withdrawn from the 2022 general election for the same district, and he advanced from the Republican primary on May 19, 2026.
